Buddha's delight.fact: Zhāi (simplified Chinese: 斋; traditional Chinese: 齋; pinyin: zhāi; Jyutping: zaai1) means "vegetarian food" or "vegetarian diet." The dish is usually made with at least 10 ingredients, although more elaborate versions may comprise 18 or even 35 ingredients. If 18 ingredients are used, the dish is called luóhàn quánzhāi (simplified: 罗汉全斋; traditional: 羅漢全齋; Jyutping: lo4hon3 cyun4zaai1).
